review.referenceImages: Both supplied JPGs visually inspected. Separate bridge-side and dial-side holders; no turnover mechanism claimed.

review.dial: ZBseite: 13.7 mm seating shoulders, 9.2 mm internal clearance floor. Source movement rotated -90 degrees around X, translated +16.3 mm world Y; plate source Z=-2.6 seats at Y=13.7.
review.holderOrientation: Both holders rotate -90 degrees around X from source Z-up to world Y-up. Crown relief stays at +X.
review.limits: Nominal static seating based on STEP planes, radial pockets and maker images; not a mechanical tolerance or holding certification.
review.redistribution: No public redistribution grant established. Originals and prepared holder payloads remain ignored/local.
